analyst_view.overall: Early view: This is a bottom-of-the-table game. Udinese are last with one point from their last five, and Tuttomercatoweb reports that Paolo Zanetti has replaced Runjaic. Fiorentina are unbeaten in three under Vanoli, but Parisi is out until at least January with a cruciate ligament injury, Pongracic, Ranieri and Atta were also missing at the last game, and De Gea has been making mistakes.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.0 goals. I lean higher: both teams have conceded 25 goals in 11 games, Fiorentina's away games have averaged about 4.4 goals, and De Gea has the lowest save rate of any regular Serie A keeper. Udinese's home games have averaged three.

corners.text: The site expects 9.2 corners. Udinese's home games have averaged about 10.5 and Fiorentina's away games under seven, so the number sits in between. Pellegrino's work on set pieces makes Fiorentina dangerous from corners, but that does not create more of them.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.0 cards. I lean slightly higher: it is a relegation game, and Fiorentina's away games have averaged about 4.6 cards. Udinese's home games have been calmer, which keeps the lean small.

shots.text: The site expects 29.6 shots, close to both Udinese's home average (about 31) and Fiorentina's away average (about 28). Fiorentina had 22 shots against Juventus, so if anything there is a little upside, but not enough to lean.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.6 shots on target. I lean higher because Udinese's home games have averaged about 11.5 on target and Udinese allow 6.2 a game, the second-worst in Serie A. Fiorentina's front line of Pellegrino, Njie and Mastantuono shoots straight.
